patterns.note: Asymmetrical hero section featuring an oversized, custom-drawn logotype and a whimsical character illustration positioned off-center, creating a dynamic and playful initial impression.

Custom, heavy, outlined display typography is used for the brand name and key section titles, providing a distinct, illustrative brand voice that contrasts with a clean, modern sans-serif for body text and navigation.

A high-contrast palette dominated by black, white, and a vibrant, almost neon green, is used for full-bleed section backgrounds and prominent call-to-action elements, creating energetic visual breaks.
The primary header transforms upon scroll, transitioning from a transparent overlay with white text to a solid white background with black text and distinct pill-shaped navigation items.

A large, whimsical character illustration in the hero section appears to be fixed or slowly parallaxes as the user scrolls, maintaining its partial presence in the viewport longer than other hero elements.
Distinctive full-width sections utilize alternating background colors (white, vibrant green, dark gray) to clearly delineate content blocks and provide visual rhythm down the page.

technique_notes: The main header dynamically changes its appearance upon scroll, transitioning from a transparent overlay with light-colored text to a solid background with dark text and distinct button-like navigation items.
Key brand typography is rendered as large, custom-drawn graphic elements rather than standard web fonts, giving a unique, illustrative quality that is integral to the brand's visual identity.

Playful, cartoonish illustrations are integrated directly into the page layout, often breaking out of content boundaries or serving as background elements, creating a whimsical and engaging visual narrative.

design_tokens.type_scale: Hero and section titles use an extremely oversized, custom display font (approx. 5-8x body text size), while body text and labels are set in a clean, legible sans-serif.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (e.g., on cards, buttons) and distinct pill-shaped elements (e.g., CTAs, scrolled nav items) are used consistently.
design_tokens.spacing: Generally airy, especially in the hero and main content sections, with generous vertical padding between sections, creating a spacious and uncluttered feel.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its bold, custom-drawn, cartoonish typography for the brand name and major section titles, paired with whimsical, hand-drawn illustrations. This creates a highly playful and unique brand identity that feels more like an animated series or a game's splash page than a typical tech website.
